criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Play Media
categories.definition: User wants to play music, podcast, audiobook, or radio station.

categories.name: Set Reminder
categories.definition: User wants to set a reminder for a specific event or task.

categories.name: Get Information
categories.definition: User wants to get information about weather, time, stock prices, definitions, etc.

categories.name: Send Communication
categories.definition: User wants to send an email, tweet, or message.

categories.name: Schedule Event
categories.definition: User wants to schedule a meeting, appointment, or event.

categories.name: Control Smart Home
categories.definition: User wants to control lights, alarms, or other smart home devices.

categories.name: Check Notifications
categories.definition: User wants to check notifications, emails, or reminders.

categories.name: Get Directions
categories.definition: User wants to get directions, find routes, or book transportation.

categories.name: Get Recommendations
categories.definition: User wants recommendations for music, news, recipes, etc.

categories.name: Perform Calculation
categories.definition: User wants to perform a calculation or math operation.

categories.name: Delete/Remove
categories.definition: User wants to delete or remove an item from a list, calendar, or device.

categories.name: General Inquiry
categories.definition: User has a general question or inquiry.
